error.invalid_host: The host URL is invalid or the hostname could not be resolved. Check for typos.

error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This vynst (inwendo ERP) instance is already configured.

init.title: Options
init.description: Every function is off by default. Functions vynst (inwendo ERP) has switched off in its settings stay inactive here too.

data.expose_ha_locks: Offer these Home Assistant locks to vynst (inwendo ERP)

data_description.import_erp_locks: Adds a lock entity for every vynst (inwendo ERP) smart lock the API key's user may use. Locking and opening go through vynst (inwendo ERP), which checks the access rights and logs every action. The API key must not be restricted to a single path.
data_description.expose_ha_locks: vynst (inwendo ERP) receives the selected locks and their states and can lock and open them once an administrator syncs the devices of the new "Home Assistant" smart lock connection. Needs an external https URL for Home Assistant (e.g. Home Assistant Cloud) and the API key scope Event (write).
data_description.occupancy_sensors: Per bookable: occupied, lead time before the next booking (pre-start), open (opening hours), next booking and participants, updated every minute and on every booking change. Needs vynst (inwendo ERP) setting integration_occupancy_api_enabled and the API key scope Location (read).
data_description.access_events: Fires iw_erp_access for every smart lock access and iw_erp_check_in for every check-in and check-out, adds "last access" sensors and logbook entries. Needs the external https URL of the webhook and vynst (inwendo ERP) setting integration_ha_access_events_enabled.
data_description.usage_counters: Shows vynst (inwendo ERP) usage counters (meters) as sensors; on the next page you can pick Home Assistant sensors whose readings are reported to them (at most every 15 minutes). Needs vynst (inwendo ERP) setting integration_usage_counter_api_enabled and the API key scope Location (read + write).
data_description.display_images: An image entity per vynst (inwendo ERP) room display, for dashboards, also for displays not assigned to an OpenDisplay panel. Displays assigned to a panel always get one.

displays.title: Room displays
displays.description: Choose the OpenDisplay panel that shows each vynst (inwendo ERP) room display. Home Assistant fetches the picture from vynst (inwendo ERP), uploads it over Bluetooth whenever it changes and reports battery, signal and last contact back to vynst (inwendo ERP). Leave a display empty to skip it. Needs the OpenDisplay integration and a local media folder.

usage_counters.title: Usage counters
usage_counters.description: Choose the Home Assistant sensor that feeds each vynst (inwendo ERP) usage counter. Only numeric readings in the counter's unit are sent, at most every 15 minutes per counter. Leave a counter empty to only show it. Counters vynst (inwendo ERP) fills from real usage data are not listed.

no_external_url.title: vynst (inwendo ERP) cannot push changes to Home Assistant
no_external_url.description: vynst (inwendo ERP) at {title} only sends webhooks to a public https URL, and Home Assistant has none (Settings > System > Network, or Home Assistant Cloud). Calendars are polled instead, and access and check-in events are not delivered. This message disappears once the webhook could be registered.

api_key_rejected.title: vynst (inwendo ERP) rejected the API key
api_key_rejected.description: vynst (inwendo ERP) at {title} rejected the API key (expired or revoked). Re-authenticate the integration under Settings > Devices & Services with a new API key.

missing_scope.title: vynst (inwendo ERP) API key lacks a scope
missing_scope.description: The API key of {title} may not use the function "{feature}" (HTTP 403). Add the scope {scope} to the API key in vynst (inwendo ERP), or switch the option off. This message disappears with the next successful request.

entry_not_loaded.message: The vynst (inwendo ERP) config entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

entry_required.message: Several vynst (inwendo ERP) connections are set up: choose one (config_entry_id).

no_entry.message: No vynst (inwendo ERP) connection is loaded.

feature_disabled.message: vynst (inwendo ERP) does not offer "{feature}": it is switched off in its settings ({setting}) or its version is too old.

missing_scope.message: The API key may not use "{feature}": it needs the scope {scope}.

api_key_rejected.message: vynst (inwendo ERP) rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration.

request_failed.message: The request to vynst (inwendo ERP) failed: {error}

not_a_bookable.message: The chosen device is not a bookable of vynst (inwendo ERP).

check_access.name: Check access
check_access.description: Asks vynst (inwendo ERP) whether a credential (card UID, QR code, keypad code) opens a smart lock, with the access rules of vynst (inwendo ERP). Writes the smart lock log of vynst (inwendo ERP) and returns the answer (granted, reason, person, smart lock).

config_entry_id.name: vynst (inwendo ERP) connection
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several vynst (inwendo ERP) instances are set up.

credential.name: Credential
credential.description: Card UID, member card number, QR code content or access code.

credential_type.name: Credential type
credential_type.description: What the credential is; "auto" lets vynst (inwendo ERP) find out.

smart_lock_id.name: vynst (inwendo ERP) smart lock ID
smart_lock_id.description: ID of the smart lock in vynst (inwendo ERP). Alternatively choose a lock entity.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: An imported vynst (inwendo ERP) lock, or a Home Assistant lock offered to vynst (inwendo ERP).

open.name: Open
open.description: Let vynst (inwendo ERP) open the lock when access is granted (locks vynst (inwendo ERP) controls itself, not Home Assistant locks).

create_ticket.name: Create ticket
create_ticket.description: Creates a ticket in vynst (inwendo ERP), e.g. for a water alarm. With a dedupe key no second ticket is created while one is open. Returns the ticket id and status.

config_entry_id.name: vynst (inwendo ERP) connection
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several vynst (inwendo ERP) instances are set up.

bookable.name: Bookable
bookable.description: The bookable (device of this integration) the ticket is about.

bookable_id.name: Bookable ID
bookable_id.description: Alternatively the id of the bookable in vynst (inwendo ERP).

dedupe_key.name: Dedupe key
dedupe_key.description: While a ticket with this key is open, no second one is created.
